body.summary: Integration tests (code-review-divided.test.ts) drive runCodeReview end to end at a small limit and at a raised one: production runner, fold, record, dimension specs, adapters and s1's driver; judge slots mirror runDimensionJob with the test's limit (the configured limit lives in ~/.insrc); a scripted model judges only from what each call carries. Same verdicts per dimension and the same overall verdict both ways, each non-empty; cross-chunk contract mismatch reported at the caller; cross-chunk duplicate reported with counterpartRef; a degraded review whose coverage call is over the limit is divided with zero atoms (pipelineCalls chunk 0, one obligation per promised test) and judges each test on its evidence; an obligation answered at a note id twice fails the review with nothing written; every call within the limit.

feedback.author: Subho Ghosh
feedback.comment: Stakeholder decision 2026-10-20 (option A): t2's fourth gate run satisfied all four acceptance checks and failed only on scope, because commit 581e1d76 (attributed to t2) also changed quality's description reasons to the same fixed-size form. That change is t3's surface (recorded on the plan) and is covered by t3's passing test. It is carried to this BUILD's approval as a scope override: '581e1d76 changed quality's reasons alongside t2's for one consistent validator module; the plan records it as t3's surface.' No re-attribution of history.
